steps.name: déjà vu
steps.objective: Report the quest to [Dana] in “Guild Alliance City Esnil.”

steps.name: Incident that calls a witch
steps.objective:
1. Listen to the story of [Kaina] in front of [Dana] and the story of [Chloris] in front of [Zelic] in 「Guild United City Esnil」.
2. When the story is over, report the quest to [Notos] at the Nereis Gate.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I have something to tell you.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: About the new witch that will appear soon... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Narsha, first let me say I’m sorry. It's important, so I think I'll have to take Adventurer with me.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, Your Majesty. I know what you mean. Then I will step down.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, let’s eat later.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, Adventurer.
(With Kaina’s hand greeting, the knights standing far away, including Narsha, step back.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Now we can talk. It's a bit sudden, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Majesty I know has always been unexpected. As if it was set, as if I was expected to do it... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: You could have seen it worse, but I'm glad you saw it that way.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Don't make such boring jokes.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I only said that because I was lucky.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Do you have a slightly unusual personality?...)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Sister. Tell me who the witch is and where she appears. Not vaguely, everything.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: You know. I don't know everything. All you have to do is learn little things a little earlier than others.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Is it trivial?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Was there anything minor in one of your sister's prophecies? The same goes for recent events. The problem is that you think such things are trivial. It was something dangerous enough to shake the world!

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Don't take it easy when so many people could have died.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: You didn't say those things were trivial, Dana.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I'm grateful that you saved my life, but I need to know. What are you hiding? How do you find out? Are you acting under an oracle or something?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Dana, I can't tell you that.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It's always like this. My sister always hides and runs away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I knew we weren't getting along well, but...)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I'm a fool to want this from my sister.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Dana, I'm going to talk now. Is that okay?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Do whatever you want… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: It's about witches and the council that will soon appear. %s… , which of the two would you like to hear first?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It wasn't one. Okay… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Which story should we hear first?)

choices.text: 1. The witch that will appear soon

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Iris Witches will continue to appear to you, the person doing your job.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Whether there is intention or not. Just like the witches I met on Aie Island... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: They… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: They know. The meaning of touching life... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What witches are trying to do... . Is that so? Like Vice was trying to do?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I can't tell you that far. Because witches have different purposes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Circe said that since she was a witch, of course she had to harm other witches...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hilda was just busy running away….)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It's too vague... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: %s, just wait for someone to come visit Dana soon... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It’s a familiar pattern that something is about to happen….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Where does Your Majesty’s prophecy come from?)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: The National Assembly was an institution created by nobles from the early days of the empire to disperse the power concentrated in the emperor.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I have been working for a long time in the name of serving the empire, but at some point, my voice became louder than that of the imperial family.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Sister, just get to the point.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: The Council made a plan to mobilize wizards and soldiers to find the witch. However, they have little information about witches.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Was that the reason why Chairman Aaron moved?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaron… ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah! The person I saw at the Nereid Gate... . I heard they were doing small things in parliament... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Aaron Kandel Tiernes. He is the current head of the Tyennes family, which has led the council since the early days of the empire.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: He's a person who rarely moves... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I saw it briefly at the Nereid Gate. I told him about the witch, saying that we might continue to meet him.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I see. First, I asked Argent to keep an eye on the movements of the council soldiers and knights.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Public sentiment may be agitated, and we must prevent the National Assembly from taking the lead... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: So?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: We must avoid conflict with the Council and witches as much as possible.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Now that Congress is in charge, do you think that's possible? no way… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What on earth is this guy named Aaron thinking?)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Dana, I have something special to ask of you.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I don’t like it… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Now I can get a little closer to what happened 10 years ago.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I'll do that. Sister, don't do that. Just worry about national affairs.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Dana, I know what you mean. However, I am the emperor of the empire, my father's daughter, and your older sister.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: In the meantime, I thought about what I could do in my position and tried my best. I think I can finally do that... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Why are you telling me not to do it?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: That's it. I don't want to hear it. So, if the story is over, go back now.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: But, you… ?
(At that time, Dana chases after a woman who is walking backwards and catches her.)

lines.speaker: 여성
lines.text: I guess I got the timing wrong. Ahaha… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: No, Mr. Chloris. Welcome.
(Every time the woman named Chloris shakes her head, her emerald blonde hair also moves.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Chloris? This name… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: %s is the same as Chloris, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, the head of the magic academy! I didn't recognize him because he looked different at that time.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Please forget that look. I feel embarrassed because the students make fun of the teacher for destroying the school.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: By the way, Mr. Chloris, you came to see me, right? Anything happens to Shiina... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: There is no problem with the princess, or Shiina. but… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Chloris, I'd like to hear your story. Shall we take a seat?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Yes, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Dana, if possible, I’d like to hear your story while eating Zelic’s dessert. Is that okay?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Do whatever you want. You always do whatever you want.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Thanks, Dana. And Chloris and %s. Let's go to the place where the pastry chef of the Monggeul Monggle Guild is located.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Dana, are you going to listen to me?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Okay, okay. You just have to listen.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: As expected, jelly food is happiness itself... . It's such a shame that this flavor is only available in Esnil.

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: That's too much praise, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Zelic, thank you too. Please tell me that the students enjoyed the bread.

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: It's rewarding to make bread with guild members. haha. Ah, this here.

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: It's nothing special, but it's a food storage bag made in the style of my hometown village. We have prepared some light food for you, so take it with you when you go.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I will eat well this time too. Zelic.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Clearly Narsha also has it.)

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: I have to make another meal, so I'll be stepping down. Have a nice time.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: It would be okay for Zelic to work as an imperial pastry chef... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Sister, stop talking like that.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I was talking to myself. But what's wrong with praising Zelic?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Are you doing this to Zelic even though you know why I can't be in the imperial castle?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: You left by your own choice. Even though I said it was okay... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: If your sister is okay, then everything is okay?!

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: That's the problem with your sister.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: The emperor of the Sylvaria Empire, Kaina Dun Sylvaria, could have given an order to capture him. Even though I fully respected your wishes, you… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: So what? Are you planning on giving orders here?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: There's nothing you can't do.
(Dana and Kaina continue to express their dissatisfaction without stopping. Cloris, caught between them, looks very anxious.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I'm fine... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty, and Mr. Dana. Weren’t you here to listen to Chloris’ story?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I'm sorry for being distracted by you. Mr. Chloris.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I'm sorry, Chloris. It's been a while since I spent time with my younger brother.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Ahaha, no. I'm fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It doesn’t look okay at all….)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Chloris, you came here through Shiina's introduction because you wanted to find Zephyrus, right?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: How did His Majesty do that…? . ah… . right.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Zephyrus went on a business trip to collect materials needed for magic research, and has not returned for over 15 days.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: So, I would like to ask Dana.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aren’t you staying on a business trip for a bit longer for research?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: That's not it... . I’m embarrassed to tell you, but… .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: After the school festival accident, I was able to feel Zephyrus' magic. .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I could feel how far away it was when Zephyrus went to Riftrasir.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it because of Windy Seed?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I think so.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Mr. Chloris, what should I do?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I want to help Mr. Chloris with his work, but I feel like I have to help His Majesty with his work too... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Mr. Dana, you are finally doing your majesty a favor...)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: No, it's okay. I'll find someone else. Thank you for just listening to me. I can't go to Riftrasir... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why? I'm an elf, why do you say I can't go to Alfheim?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: The story is a bit long.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Chloris, it's okay. There is no place that people from the Sylvarian Empire cannot go.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: But… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: %s, please take care of Chloris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Please find Zephyrus together. Then you will get closer to the answer you want. You can trust me because I am speaking from my ability.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Since it's your Majesty's word, nothing can go wrong.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Your Majesty, is it really okay for me to go?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: No matter how humble you are, you probably know that you shouldn't touch the emperor's people. Please visit safely.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: After hearing your Majesty’s words, I regret my hesitation. Even though I know I have to go there to find him anyway.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Don’t forget that you are from the Sylvaria Empire. Then, as soon as you are ready, go to the Nereid Gate and talk to Nototh. It will open the gate.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Yes… ? Notos? Notos? Notos… . Ugh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Why would Chloris do that?)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Ah, I see. your majesty.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Well then, it was nice to meet you two. I have something to talk about with my prickly younger brother, so I'll leave now.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Hehe, I put you through a lot of trouble because of your stupid sister. Sister, it's just 5 minutes. No more than that.
(As the two disappear somewhere to talk, Chloris wipes away her cold sweat.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I never imagined that I would meet His Majesty like this... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Me too.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Thank you again for the school festival work. Oh, now the name of the school festival will change.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne… .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Hey %s, despite your Majesty's words, would you mind accompanying me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. There is something I want to find out.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It would be important if %s was with you, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: His Majesty has come to Esnil to speak with Mr. Dayna about a new witch who will soon appear.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And if you look at the fact that he told me to follow the director... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: The story is that a witch may be in Riftrasir.
(For a moment, Chloris makes a solemn expression as if she has decided on something.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: %s. I'll go back to that school and get my luggage. When you're ready, come to the Nereis Gate.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will go to the Nereis Gate when I am ready.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I thought the school festival ended there, but it continues like this... It's always been like this, but I have no choice but to go first...)

steps.name: Toward Alfheim
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Notos] at the “Nereis Gate” and use the “Liftrashit” gate. 
2.  Arrive at “Riftrasir” and report the quest to [Rashur].

lines.text: (The Nereis gateway is once again crowded with people crossing the western and eastern parts of the Freios continent.)
(As we pass through the crowd of people and approach the large building, we see the back of Chloris, who is contemplating something.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Academy director?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Are you here, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You came early.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I just arrived too. Oh, I… . Could you please call me Chloris?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's a little embarrassing to be called by titles like academy director or principal outside.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still, I can't just call you by your first name, so should I call you like Dana?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Okay, I'll call it that too. Mr. %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There is a lounge inside, so you can wait there.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: There's Notos inside... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why is that?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: … I made a mistake with Notos in the past... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could it be that you mistook Notos for Zephyros and confessed to him, hugged him from behind, gave him a gift, or something like that?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: How... .
(Cloris looks embarrassed and then tries to act like nothing has happened.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Oh, nothing happened! Oh, I guess someone is coming out.
(The door to the gateway center opens, and someone walks out from inside. Then, he greets %s as if he has seen him.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Welcome, %s. uh? Chloris?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello Notos.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Notos… . long time no see.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: How many years has this been?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: How have you been? I heard that you became the head of a magic academy... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Thanks to you, I'm doing well.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Are you okay with having a hard time at the school festival?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Yeah, well... . I came to the gate because I had to go to Riftrasir.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: The gate inspection has been completed by order of His Majesty. Use the gateway inside.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: What? I'm just thankful that you always take good care of my younger brother.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I'm sorry, Notos.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ah, it looks like Notos doesn’t know Zephyros’ story yet.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Oh, that's right... .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: You don't have to feel sorry for breaking up with Zephyrus. Zephyrus must have been wrong, hahaha.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: That's right, Jeffy was wrong... . sorry. I didn't mean to make a fuss... .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: It's okay. Chloris is saying this because she cares for Zephyrus.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Notos, I’m going now. I don't have time... .
(Chloris turns her back and hurries towards the gateway.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Chloris… .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: %s, don't worry about me and quickly chase after Chloris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. See you later then.
(Chloris is looking at the gate that is moving with powerful magic.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Chloris, you are here.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I was mentally preparing.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's been a really long time since I went to Alfheim.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This may be rude, but he looks a little uneasy.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: That's right. I'm a little anxious. I wasn't welcome in Alfheim. Of course, even the Sylvaria Empire did not welcome it very much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, why?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: A mixed race of humans and elves. For that reason, there weren't many places that would accept me.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's okay now. I was able to forget about all that just by being at school.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: My fellow wizards who teach students don't seem to care much, and there are many students who follow me.
(Cloris smiles brightly. The anxious expression from just a moment ago is nowhere to be seen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Cloris really likes school.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's a shame that I wasn't able to enroll, but I'm so happy that I'm attending school like this.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Still, I hate going to work on days when I have a lot of work to do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haha, we all feel the same way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?
(The moment you approach the gate, the surroundings suddenly become dark.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: %s felt it too, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's dark out here now, right?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: That's right. Someone is giving an unspoken warning not to come here.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It looks like they installed some device here... , I saw the wrong person.
(When Chloris extends her hand with her eyes closed, a cold wind flowing from the empty sea flows in and closes her eyes. And through the wind, stems of plants sprout.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is... .
(Following Chloris's hand gestures, the leaves that have fallen from the stems are blown by the wind and circle around the gate.)
(Then the dark surrounding scenery slowly returns to the clear and clean original Nereid Gate.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: That's enough for now.
(As Chloris smiles, the wind wrapped around her hand and the stem of the plant slowly disappear.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: This is also the influence of Windy Seed... . You can now use magic without holding a wand or a spellbook. I think I received a good gift.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: The space and time here is slightly distorted.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: After the school festival, I felt a strange feeling that I couldn't explain in words.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I read old magic books to find the cause, but there was no exact answer. Other than experiencing, feeling, and confirming… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I remembered Zephyrus, a time spirit I once met who turned into me.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: If the spirit told me... . It is clear that Zephyrus has been affected by time. Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Mr. %s, shall we go now? No matter how much I talk about it here, I won't get an answer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .
(Chloris swallows dry saliva and slowly enters the gate toward Riftrasir. Then, %s's steps follow.)
Wow!
(Someone, in the empty sky, sees that the two people have disappeared through the gate and is amazed.)
Wow, wow, wow!! It's a lock, a lock!
It's a real lock from my memory! Wow, wow!!

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: This is Liftrasir… .
(With Chloris’ words, a village colored in purple unfolds under a clear blue sky.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow… .
(Among the buildings filled with the unique atmosphere of an elf village, a large elf statue holding a sword toward the sky stands tall.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: That's a stone statue of a legendary elf warrior. The name of the hero is not known, but it is said that he fought against the demons that appeared on the Continent of Freios.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: If you are curious about more, you may want to listen to Professor Theodore's lecture.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I get a chance, I'd like to hear it.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Or you can ask the villagers.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that so? Hmm… . Uh, here… .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It feels a little different from the human village. Should I say that the air is cleaner and clearer... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's because of the forest nearby. Apparently, the Crystal Moon Forest is under the influence of spirits... . By the way, what is that orange ribbon on your wrist?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... . Since when has this been happening?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I think it caught something that fell from someone else's clothes as it entered the gate. Don't worry too much. First of all, we… .
(The moment Chloris is about to continue speaking, a blond elf boy who appears to be a resident of Riftrasir appears.)

lines.speaker: 엘프 소년
lines.text: Welcome to Riftrasir!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you a village resident?

lines.speaker: 엘프 소년
lines.text: I'm Coren! nice to meet you! I'll guide you! Our village is the home of a legendary elf warrior... .
(An elf boy who introduces himself as Coren makes eye contact with Chloris.)

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: To the hometown of the elf warrior... . Wow... .
(As soon as Koren makes eye contact with Chloris, he takes a step back. Then he quickly runs away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you running away instead of just introducing it?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's because of me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? No way… .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Freios elves instinctively sense beings of different blood. And we take that as something unclean, not something else.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: That kid must have been like that too. It has been engraved that way since ancient times.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Usually, they just look at it in a negative light... . What is happening when I see you running away like that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still, it's not a good idea to look at people like that.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Humans and elves think differently.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you are discriminating?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not just elves, though... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Mr. %s, I wish we wouldn't have to talk about this here. There are more important things than that right now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry. I was short-thinking.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's okay. If you talk to people in Riftrasir, this will happen again and again.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: %s, please focus on what you originally wanted to do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Thank you. Should we go ask other people then?

steps.name: Exploring the Elven Village
steps.objective: Talk to [Lasur], [Koren], and [Runton] in “Riftrasir.” And finally, report the quest to [Leaf].

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Uh… , that person… .
(Chloris stops and looks at a human male.)
(A man wearing a luxurious coat and sparkling jewelry looks at Chloris and smiles coolly.)
Oh, what is going on here, Director Chloris?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Mr. Rashur, what brought you here?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Hahaha. What brought me here? I go anywhere if there is money to be made.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: The chief of Riftrasir wanted to distribute goods from here to the empire, so I came first to check.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: You said so.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Chloris, if you know someone, please introduce me.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: You don't know me? Then I'll tell you. I am Rashur, the leader of the Empire's highest rank [Lichberry]. Remember.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: If you say you know me, at least you won't suffer any loss. Because I am that kind of person.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That’s a lot of confidence.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I was going to introduce you, but you played first.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: The best way to introduce yourself is to introduce yourself, academy director.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Mr. %s, Mr. Lasure continues to donate a large amount of money to the students every quarter, asking us to use it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's amazing.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Hahaha, what can you do with that much? This is something that the head of Richberry should definitely do. By the way, I'm curious about you, please introduce yourself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Introduce yourself briefly to Rashur.)

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: %s? I think I've heard of it. If I've heard it, you probably aren't an average bet either. Hahaha, nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: I have some time left to meet Chief Leaf, but I'm bored. Would you and the academy director want to talk for a moment?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Of course, I won't let you waste your time as you please. I'll give you enough credit.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I'm sorry, Lashur. Because we have work to do.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Hehe, I can't help it.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Have you ever seen the Chairman here?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Chairman? Is Chairman Zephyros also here? It's been a while since I came here so I haven't seen it before.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Is something wrong?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's not something you should worry about. Well then, we're busy so we'll just leave.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Okay, academy director. See you later then. I'll bring something the students will like!

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Thank you, Mr. Lashur.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Well, I hope %s has a good trip too.
(Lashur raises his hand in a nice greeting and disappears somewhere in the village.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You seem like a special person.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Not a little bit. A lot. You get a little tired while talking, but you're a good person.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Build buildings for students and donate to buy a lot of textbooks. I didn't expect to see you here like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Since there don't seem to be any people from the Old World Empire here, let's ask the elves for their stories.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: After that, I think you can go see Chief Leaf.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Mr. Chloris.
(Coren stares at the %s group who approached him.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you say Koren?

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Huh? huh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did you suddenly run away?

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Sorry, sorry. I did it wrong. I know it's wrong, but I'm scared.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Is it because of me too?

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Yeah. little… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why is that?
(Chloris grabs %s's shoulder and shakes her head.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: %s, this is Alfheim.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I understand, Coren. It's okay if you realize it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It reminds me of the people of the empire who did not consider people like Narsha as the same people, saying they were beastmen. When I see the elves also treating mixed race people like this...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I wonder if I unconsciously treated someone with prejudice...)

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: I won't do that in the future. It's been a really long time since I've seen a mixed race person, and it was a long time ago... .

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Something bad just happened in town.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I have something to ask.

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: It doesn't matter if it's just an old story.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I'm looking for a friend. He came to Riftrasir before us, but we haven't heard from him since.

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Yeah? Please tell me about facial expressions. I have a good memory, so I'll tell you right away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since you and Notos are twins, may I explain?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Let me explain. They're twins, but they're a little different.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: He is a human man with green eyes like olivine and who wears black glasses when reading a book.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Although he always has a stern expression, sometimes he smiles and it's soft. He will be wearing a wizard outfit with the imperial emblem on it.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: The name is Zephyrus... .

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Ah, that person! I think I saw it... .
(While Koren is tracing his memories, he looks embarrassed.)

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Sorry… . I don't remember very well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don’t think they did it on purpose…)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's okay. There are a lot of people looking for this place, so you might not remember it.
(Cloris looks slightly disappointed.)

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: How long will you be in our village?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll leave as soon as I find someone.

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: But if you were wearing a wizard costume, are you a wizard?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: That's right, wizard... .
(Koren's eyes begin to sparkle at the word wizard.)

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Wow, wizard! I've never seen a wizard! Amazing!

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Coren, if you remember anything later, let me know. Then I'll show you a simple magic trick.

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Really? Really! Okay, sister!

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Sister… ? Ahaha… .
(Cloris smiles bitterly when Coren changes his attitude.)

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: What is your sister's name?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Chloris… Please call me. If it's long, you can call it Chloe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Mr. Chloris….)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Then we'll go to the other elf. Coren, thank you.

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Chloris, shall we leave now?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Yes… .
(A tall, silver-haired young elf is staring at the %s party approaching him.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This time I'll ask.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Please.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, are you a resident of Riftrasir? Can I ask you something?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you there?
What's going on? I'm shy and my speech is a little slow... . sorry… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Thank you for visiting the village. My name is Runton, and I am the forest keeper of Crystal Moon Forest. Are you from the Empire?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… . I'm from the East. By the way, are you okay now?

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Yes, it's okay. What do you want to ask... . Is this somehow related to that person?
(For a moment, Runton and Chloris' eyes meet.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: My friend arrived at Riftrasir first, but I couldn't contact him.

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: People in the empire may wonder why they do that, but the elves of Alfheim are of mixed blood… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You don’t have to talk about that separately. Actually, there is no major problem... .

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: In our village, it's not good for mixed race people... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That doesn't mean... . Oh, no. Because this is Alfheim... .

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there anyone named Zephyrus among those who have recently visited the forest and village?

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Zephyrus? I'm not sure about your name, but if you tell me what you're wearing, I might be able to find out... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… . Mr. Chloris. Zephyrus, I think you need to explain your facial expressions... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: He's human, and he's taller than me. He has green eyes like olivine and wears black glasses.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Although he always has a stern expression, sometimes he smiles and it's soft. And he'll be wearing a wizard's outfit with the imperial emblem on it.

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Are you holding a magic book or something?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Uh, have you seen it?

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Just a moment. uh… ?
(Lunton looks confused and looks embarrassed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What…?)

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Sorry. A wizard rarely visits... . I suddenly couldn't remember... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It can't be helped. There are not just one or two people visiting this place... .

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: If I think of something later, I'll let you know right away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Runton.

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Yes… , then I hope you have a nice trip… . I have to go on patrol... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It was a good trip… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Chloris, let’s go.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Yes… .

steps.name: error in memory
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Leaf] in 「Riftrasir」, and use the village portal to go to 「Crystal Moon Forest」.

lines.text: (While the little elf girl was busy running around, she noticed a group of %s approaching her.)
Welcome to Riftrasir! Questions are always welcome. If you have any questions, please visit Leaf. ah… .
(The elf girl who introduced herself as Leaf stops moving when she sees Chloris.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As expected of Mr. Chloris….)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Hello, Chief Leaf.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chief?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: He said he was the village chief, so I almost answered yes without thinking. Welcome, Director of Chloris Academy.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Yes, warden. It’s been a while since I last saw you. This is our first time seeing you since the school festival, right?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I see. Thank you for inviting me to the school festival two years ago.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: And I will apologize for the rudeness of the residents.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's okay. It's something I'm familiar with, so don't worry about it.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: They're all good kids, but... . I'm a little traumatized by what happened in the past.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I heard something while passing by and something must have happened in the village.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: It was a long time ago. It's not something the academy director should worry about. Principal, could you introduce me to the person next to me?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: This is %s. I don't know if you know, but he is a hero who helped with Zerenis Academy and solved problems on other continents.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, not to that extent.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Ah! It's him. I heard the story.
(Suddenly Leaf's eyes sparkle.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: How about spending your later years in Riftrasir? A new hero sleeps in Riftrasir along with the legendary warrior, isn't it cool?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm still fine.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Think about it for a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: From now on, I don't want to think about what happened back then.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: It's a shame. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Seeing as how he immediately thinks about making money, he is not an ordinary person.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Academy Director, what brought you here? An official letter requesting cooperation came from the Sylvaria Empire, is that it?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Let's see.
(Leaf takes out a piece of paper from his pocket and begins to read.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: The Liftrasir Management Office requests your cooperation. Provide information about one visitor to the village to Visitor Cloris and %s... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Even in the early days of the empire, something like this never happened, so what is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Director, the early days of the founding of the nation?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Ahaha, that's what it says. Now that I've stopped making silly jokes, please tell me about the person you're looking for.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is Zephyrus. Mr. Chloris will explain.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: He's human, and he's taller than me. He has green eyes like olivine and wears black glasses.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Although he always has a stern expression, sometimes he smiles and it's soft. And he'll be wearing a wizard's outfit with the imperial emblem on it.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: It wasn't that soft, was it? I thought there were people who smiled awkwardly like that... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, Zephyrus came and went?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I revealed my identity and said I was going to get ingredients for a magic tool, so I gave permission. They said I only needed a very small amount, so I allowed it, otherwise I wouldn't have allowed it.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I waited for them to come back and report how much they collected, but they never came.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Just in case, I told Runton to search the forest and Coren to check the lodgings. However, I didn't see him so I thought he had gone right back.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: That's not it... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Then, I will give you permission to enter not only the general Crystal Moon Forest area but also other restricted areas.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I'll also talk to Runton, the forest keeper, so if you feel like wandering around the forest, go to Runton at the rest area in the center of the forest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Thank you, Director.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: You said that if you receive help, you will repay it double, right? I look forward to it.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I have a lot of work to do, so I don't think I can go to the forest with you. There's a map here and signs outside, so you won't get lost.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: You cared so much, but your words are enough.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I will also gather information here, so don't worry too much. It'll be fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then we will go to the forest. Chief… .
(For a moment, Leaf makes eye contact and winks.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, Chief Leaf.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: See you later, Chief.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: What… .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Oh, wait… . What, what is it? The atmosphere in the town is strange... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's definitely different inside and outside the village.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is the Crystal Moon Forest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The outside of the village was dyed purple, so I wanted to see it for myself, but it was more beautiful than I thought.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It’s a forest where you can feel good energy, but… , something feels awkward.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: The fact is that the elven forest that has existed since ancient times has become a park. I knew that the forest changed as the village developed. I feel a little strange... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Oh, and the fact that I'm here too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: That's how it should be. When will I come to the Crystal Moon Forest? I came here because of Jeffy.
(As Chloris's self-deprecating joke ends, people passing by to see the forest.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It may seem a little early, but there are some people walking in the forest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sure. There are people across the lake too.
(A group of people with a different vibe from regular tourists are looking around from across the lake.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Did I lose something?)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Mr. %s, I have a favor to ask.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? What is it?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I want to stand here without saying a word and take in the scenery with my eyes. It just takes a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, if that's the case, I'd like it too. Let’s watch it together.
(Chloris nods and turns her head to look at the scenery of the Crystal Moon Forest for a long time.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Phew, the end. Shall we go now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you look at the map, there is a cathedral over here.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: The cathedral is a bit far, so let’s go there last. By the way, Mr. %s. Do you know this kid?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who?
(Chloris points to a girl who is pulling %s's clothes with her hands.)

lines.speaker: 여자아이
lines.text: Wow! Hello locks! hi!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um, since when did this happen?
(A girl wearing a helmet I think I saw somewhere smiles brightly.)

lines.speaker: 여자아이
lines.text: Lock! I missed you!! Did the lock miss me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is he talking about... . do you know me

lines.speaker: 여자아이
lines.text: Yes! I know, I know!

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: This kid seems to know %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is my first time seeing this child.

lines.speaker: 여자아이
lines.text: This is my first time seeing a lock too! lol… .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Hey, can you tell me your name?

lines.speaker: 여자아이
lines.text: Mordred!
(The girl who introduces herself as Mordred jumps up and down. No one notices that something falls from Mordred's arms.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why do you call me a lock?
(Mordred pouts and scratches his head.)

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Wow, what is it if it's not a lock? key?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: key… ?
(The moment Mordred says it is the key, the Crystal Moon Forest, which used to shine purple, is engulfed in darkness and begins to shake at high speed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, I’m dizzy… . Chloris… seed?
(Chloris' movement is stopped as if she is standing on the border of time. However, other beings who have dug in between appear and capture Mordred, who is trying to move.)

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: … Why are you awake? In a space where everyone has stopped, why are you the only one... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who… ?

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: Mordred, I told you to stay by my side, right?

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Sorry. lol.

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: Phew… . We'll have to change our plans, Merlin.

lines.speaker: 수상한 남성
lines.text: I understand… .
(The man named Merlin nods and hangs Mordred on his shoulder. Then a suspicious woman approaches %s, who is suffering from dizziness.)

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: I don't know who you are... . You shouldn't remember us. So I'll make it like you didn't see it. This is for everyone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, uh… .
(The woman holds the pendant she was holding close to %s's eyes. When she slightly tilts the back of her hand, the pendant slowly swings left and right.)

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: Thought of life. Go back to the air of the beginning before it became a memory... .
(As the woman speaks, a dark shadow flows from the tip of the pendant. And it swallows up the remaining light around %s.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: The cathedral is a bit far, so let’s go there last.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What is it? I feel like déjà vu….)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Mr. %s, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We were looking at the forest scenery here, right?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: That's right. Were you thinking of something else?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not like that... . There must have been something here. uh? What is this?
(Cloris picks up what had fallen at %s’s feet and holds it in her hand.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: This is a letter... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: My name is written on the envelope.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Notos, my friend and brother... . Zephyr must have received Notos' letter.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So that means Zephyrus was here... . uh? uh!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you notice anything strange?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Runton and Coren didn't remember Zephyrus. It felt like I definitely knew, but I said I couldn't remember.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: That's right. uh?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I obviously didn't notice that until just now. And there was a little girl here, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A child?
(Images of unknown people appear in my head and then disappear in an instant.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mode… Red? It was called Mordred. Ah, I think I understand now. He suddenly appeared and locked me… , key… I called it… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And what Mordred was wearing was clearly Vice's helmet... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Stay calm… . Do you remember everything that happened?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I think I remember now. There was a group of people who came looking for a girl... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Chloris all the memories that come to mind.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It seems like things are coming together little by little now. The woman with the pendant made it impossible for us to remember that we had just met them.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Likewise, the villagers were also prevented from remembering Zephyr.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I don't know if the child named Mordred dropped this letter on purpose or by mistake... , we were able to recollect hidden memories by touching them.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Thank goodness. There is magic left in this letter... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have to hurry and find those people. Because other people may be at risk.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Yes. Hey, shall we go from there? I can feel a powerful magical force over there.
(Chloris turns her gaze and points to one side. At that moment, the wind blowing from inside the forest gives a chilling feeling.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think there's a group of people over there who aren't very happy about us coming.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Yes… . I think I need to be prepared and go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then let’s go… .

steps.name: shadow in the forest
steps.objective: Defeat [Lovely Hippo] and [White Hedgehog] in “Crystal Moon Forest” and report to [Runton] in “Crystal Moon Forest.”

lines.text: “Notice from Riftrasir!”

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Director?
(Leef's voice echoes through the Crystal Moon Forest.)

lines.speaker: 리프의 목소리
lines.text: “Travelers, please return to the village quickly!! “It’s an emergency!”

lines.speaker: 리프의 목소리
lines.text: “I inform you once again. Travelers, please return to the village quickly!! “Forest keepers, please evacuate the travelers in the forest to the village as soon as possible.”
(Leif's voice announces danger in the Crystal Moon Forest.)

lines.speaker: 숲지기 1
lines.text: What's going on? If the director says this... .

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: I heard that you have the ability to spread your voice through the forest... .
(No sooner have Runton finished speaking than a deep darkness begins to fall over the Crystal Moon Forest, which was once full of purple light.)

lines.speaker: 숲지기 1
lines.text: What, what?

lines.speaker: 숲지기 2
lines.text: There's definitely something strange. Runton, let’s go!

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: I hope that the two of you will take the travelers you see with you as you leave.

lines.speaker: 숲지기 2
lines.text: Runton, what are you going to do?

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: We have to chase after the animals flocking there.

lines.speaker: 숲지기 1
lines.text: Where are the animals... . uh?!
(The forest guards are surprised to find animals running in response to magic power. Then Runton hurries to push the two people on their backs.)

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: We will chase the animals and protect them if anyone comes to this shelter.

lines.speaker: 숲지기 1
lines.text: Are you okay alone?

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Working with animals is something I’m good at… . Come on!
(The other forest guards nod their heads at Runton’s words and quickly run toward the shortcut.)

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: As I said, how are we going to chase away all those hippopotamuses and hedgehogs... ?

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Let's give it a try.
(As he is chasing and dealing with many animals, two people appear in front of Runton.)

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: It's dangerous here... . You… ?
(The thorn tree's trunk rises, and the leaves blow in the wind, blocking the animals' path. Animals that are surprised by this situation may retreat in surprise.)

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Magic… .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's dangerous here alone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Runton, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: It's okay. For the two of you... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry about us. First, let’s chase away the animals around us.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: There are other sinister beings besides animals. %s, please take care of that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Mr. Chloris! Runton steps back. Now we'll do it!

steps.name: Crystal Moon Forest Restricted Area
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Runton] in 「Crystal Moon Forest」, and enter the 「Crystal Moon Forest Restricted Area」.
2. After what happens in the “Crystal Moon Forest Restricted Area” is over, return to [Runton] in “Rifthrasir” and report the quest.

lines.text: (Due to the two people's activities, animals and other beings that threatened people disappear.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, I can take a breather now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Runton, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: I'm fine. Thanks to you, tourists in the forest can now return to their villages.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: That's a relief.
(As Chloris looks at Runton, the beautiful flowers and tree trunks created by magic disappear.)

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: … It's beautiful magic. How can you not know that there is someone who beautifully manipulates flowers, trees, and wind magic? .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's not a skill worth bragging about. In fact, it wasn't even my own strength... .

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: No, you are amazing... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Chloris. You should check with Runton, right?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: That's how it should be. Runton, do you remember Zephyrus?

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Yes, I remember… do. The moment I heard from Director Leaf that we needed to find him, something felt strange.

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Then suddenly a memory came back to me.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: As expected... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think that happened when I held the letter in my hand.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Runton, please continue speaking.

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: It was a moment when my memories, hidden behind a blackout curtain, came into the light. I took that male wizard to the forest. It was clearly named Zephyrus... .

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: This is what he looked like, right?
(Lunton squats down and draws a human face using a fallen tree branch. Cloris looks at the drawing and bursts into laughter.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A blue long-haired wizard wearing glasses with a dissatisfied expression... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Hahaha, that’s right, Zephyrus. You drew it so exactly. So where did you lead Zephyrus?

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: There is a place in the forest where the moon energy is strong. We were restricted to going only with Director Leaf's permission, but when the permission came up, we took him there.

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Now that I think about it, it seems like my memories and him disappeared there... . That was already a few days ago... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Runton, can you tell me where it is? It's not a place on the map, right?

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Here, this way.
(Lunton takes a pen out of his pocket and marks an X on the map in %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: I will guide you.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: No. Runton, take instructions from Director Leaf.

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: I am the forest keeper of Crystal Moon Forest. Doing the work here is my duty and mission. What happened here... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Think about the best thing Runton can do now. There's nothing a normal elf can do to get there.

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Ah… … .
(Lunton nods as if he realized something at Chloris’ words.)

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I'm sorry. I'll just accept your willingness to help. or not… .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Please help me twice next time.

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Normally, when half-elves receive help, they help twice as much. This is because there are fewer opportunities to receive help... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: You're saying you're going to help that half-elf. So, if you help twice, it will be better to help you next time, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a strange statement that doesn't make any sense, but when Mr. Chloris says it, it makes a bit of sense.

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Right... Did you do it?

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Then please be careful.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Thank you, Runton.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, Runton.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Chloris?
(Chloris is mumbling something unintelligible with her eyes closed.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Wait, I quickly memorized the spell. I don't know when I'll use it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Just in case. If the memories of the people in the village and forest were erased, they must not be ordinary people... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So are we done now?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: For now. Phew… . So shall we go now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.
(After looking at the map, I arrived at the inside of the Crystal Moon Forest. In particular, I saw a forest path with a darker purple color than other places.)
(After going some distance through the bushes, Chloris' steps ahead stop.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Chloris, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: We are now in a distorted space and time. It's a little different than the one at the Gateway Gate.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It felt so natural that I only realized it now... . ha… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who made this place... ? How do I get out? Hmm… . No matter how I look at it, it doesn't seem to be the other side... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Can you see it? excuse me… .
(A wall that was not visible until just now has been built where Chloris pointed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A wall that glows green... . I've seen this wall before. This is... .
(As you approach the wall, a familiar person appears from behind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Could Hilda be the witch that will appear soon that His Majesty spoke of...?)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Do you remember my name? Ah, not this. Why are you here?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Why do you keep looking for me? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's what I want to ask.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Everyone, don’t come closer! You can't come closer... .
(Hilda extends her hand, and a new wall of green light rises in front of %s.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I feel dizzy. It's all because of you... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: %s, who are you talking to? And this wall… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Chloris, can’t you see the person in front of you right now?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I only heard sounds, but I couldn't see anything... . What about the woman in front of me... .
(Hilda, who was having a hard time, raises her head and looks at Chloris while holding on to the wall.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Academy Director, please tell %s to go back.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: For now, Mr. %s, step back. Then we talk.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, Mr. Chloris. Hilda, I'll do as you say.
(Hilda, who was complaining of dizziness, sits down.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Did you say Hilda? You know me.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: When I hid in the academy's main building for a moment, I saw... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Our teachers and staff are all skilled wizards. I can't believe people like that didn't notice you hiding in the school... . Well, I was like that too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda, are you still hiding?
(Hilda makes an embarrassed expression and then nods.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Why are you hiding?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I can't tell you, sorry... . Just leave quietly... . If you keep walking backwards, you'll be able to get out again. So please… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda is still hiding here, and if we keep looking for her, we'll see her again.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Chairman?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Do you know Zephyrus?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: A powerful magical power appeared and disappeared. Was it the chairman? Actually, I didn't know who it was... .no way… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I think another witch took her. Why... .
(Before Hilda finishes speaking, everything visible, including the green wall, shakes as if distorted.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what is it?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: This is... .
(Everything in sight slowly splits as if glass had broken. Even Hilda, who was at the center of it.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Memories are a sequence of time... . The one trying to come here now is the Witch of Memory... . Perhaps someone with the power of time was needed.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: That's all I can tell you. Goodbye now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: %s, I must live, I cannot die at the hands of a witch!!
(Hilda runs towards the green wall built inside. The door embraces Hilda and evaporates on the spot.)
(As soon as Hilda disappears, the figure of someone hidden among the shaking and cracking landscape is slowly revealed.)
(A shadow appears and disappears repeatedly around the woman. The woman continues to fiddle with the pendant in her hand as if she doesn't care.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you… .

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: I thought the cat I was looking for was in the box, but it seems it ran away... .

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: Disappearing is a better choice than dying meaninglessly. So much so that I want to praise it... .
(The woman who was mumbling something unintelligible makes eye contact with %s.)

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: Are you here to stop me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: I'm asking if you're going to stop me like you stopped Arthur from going to Azrael.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arthur?

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: Arthur is my nickname... .

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: I don't blame you for not being the key. Even if it’s not Arthur’s method, there are many other methods… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Vice?

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: That's right. My Arthur is the Weiss you know who has already disappeared from this world.

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: So, why are you moving? I should stop like that woman... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Chloris?!
(Looking in the direction the suspicious woman is pointing, Chloris stops with her hand outstretched.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Chloris?!

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: My body doesn't move... This is... . Ugh… .
(Cloris barely opens her mouth with a pained expression.)

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: I don't know how long an elf wizard can survive in this distorted space and time... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did you do it... . bondage… ?

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: No. I simply split a portion of time and space from various worlds and overlaid it here. The moment when something that shouldn't be here exists... .

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: There's no need to explain this, but I'm doing it.

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: If Mordred hadn't done something useless, it would have been over already... . I'm really tired.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Free Mr. Chloris immediately!!

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: I don't want to make things complicated, so I'll go back. Forget everything. I'll make you forget everything. It would be better that way.

lines.speaker: 수상한 여성
lines.text: You have no other choice anyway.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Quickly release Mr. Chloris.
(The expressionless woman smiles lightly as %s's hand, which was holding the weapon, tightens.)
Morgana, stop.
(A man dressed in black appears calling the woman's name.)

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Phew… .
(Morgana sighs and shakes the pendant she was holding. Then Chloris, who had stopped, loses her strength and falls down.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Chloris!

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Cluck, cluck. I'm fine. eww… . Please help me stand up.
(Morgana, who was looking at the two people, quietly steps back.)

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: That woman is also half... .

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Are you ready?

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Preparations are over, but there is still some time left for the star song to begin.
(Morgana, who heard Merlin's answer, smiles slightly as if she is satisfied. Then she says something in a quiet voice to Merlin next to her.)

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Someone's coming, Merlin.

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Never mind, Morgana.
(Merlin chuckles and walks in front of Morgana. After a moment, something dark red appears behind him as he lowers his head.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wings… ?
(As soon as Merlin's dark red wings wrap around Morgana, everything around him, including him, disappears as if they had evaporated.)
(The suspicious shadows that stayed around also disappear and return to the original, clean purple forest.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It disappeared in an instant... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I think they're preparing for something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Chloris, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Since it was temporary, I got better quickly... . I never thought I would feel this way again. Even when it was fused with Windy Seed, it was really bad... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I've heard the name Morgana from students. They say it comforts and heals people who are struggling with bad memories.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: If this is the type of treatment, I will decline. A way to erase or distort memories... . There was already one memory that had been erased before.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: By the way, Morgana mentioned Weiss... . Have you ever seen this while you were in Eastland?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I've never seen it. However, I think it's true that he was with Vice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The girl who was with Morgana was wearing the same helmet that Weiss was wearing. It seems small in size, but… .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I see. and… .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Since Hilda ran away and said she couldn't be killed by a witch, Morgana must be a witch, right? The same goes for someone named Hilda... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Chloris, how did you… … .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: His Majesty also said that a witch would appear soon... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: When I returned from a brief stay in Glaston to receive treatment for an accident at the academy, there was someone waiting for me in the academy director's office.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Did I mention this earlier? There is one memory that has been erased... . That's the witch Daphne... .
(Just as Chloris is about to continue speaking, Runton is seen rushing urgently from afar.)

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Are you two okay?!

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: … Mr. %s, we'll talk later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Runton, we're okay.

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: I'm glad that nothing seems to have happened. I was searching again to see if anyone had left the forest, and someone I knew showed up... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you talking about the blue and red odd-eye elf with black hair?

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Have you ever seen that guy? That guy grew up with me as a child... . therefore… .
(Runton is in a cold sweat and suffering.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Runton, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: I don't remember the name. The name is… . His name is... . And how we played together... . How did you end up in the village? .

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: I'm sure he knows someone... . Why can't I remember... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Don’t force yourself to remember, Runton.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems like Morgana is like that again.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I think Morgana erased or distorted not only Zephyrus but also things related to that man from the villagers' memories.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All the memories of the village people... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Chloris, I think you should go to town and check.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Yes, Mr. %s. And Runton?

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Yes… ?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Since my current situation looks unstable, it would be best to go back and rest first.

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: What I have to do now... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: … The other forest guards and Director Leaf will also want Runton to come back.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Would you like me to use some magic here to calm your mind and body? Then the amount of help Runton will have to give me will be quadruple, not double... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Mr. Chloris, that is almost at the level of a threat...)
(Lunton quietly nods his head as if he agrees with Cloris’ words and turns his back.)

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Okay. Please follow me.

steps.name: Check for errors
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Runton], [Lashur], and [Koren] in 「Riftrasir」.
2. Then, talk to [Chloris] on the bench in front of [Leaf], and report the quest to [Leaf].

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: … It seems like all the tourists and villagers have returned... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Runton, please go back and rest for now. We'll tell you, Director Leaf.

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Still, report... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: So should we multiply it by eight?

lines.speaker: 런튼
lines.text: Okay.
(Lunton nods lightly, as if resigned, and enters a building that appears to be a house.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Mr. %s, why?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel like I'm quite skilled at it.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: This is a method I learned while teaching students. Especially male students.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Why is that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haha, it's nothing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then, let's check the condition of the people in the village and go to the warden.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: I'm trying to have a nice rest, but it's noisy. Why are the Dokhalf priests here?
(Lashur, looking at the people evacuated by the forest guards, stretches lightly.)

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: I don't know what's going on, but it doesn't seem like it's profitable.
(Meanwhile, I make eye contact with the approaching Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Rashour, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Oh, %s and the head of Chloris Academy. Are you done?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Not yet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It looks like everything is going well with Mr. Lashur.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Nothing much happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: We signed a distribution contract for Liftrasir's good products on good terms. ha ha ha.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Congratulations, Mr. Lashur.
(Lashur rubs his head with a relaxed smile. Chloris applauds with an unimpressed expression, as if she is used to this kind of Lashur.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Rashur, did you notice anything strange while you were in town?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Well? The seemingly cautious Chief Leaf said he was in a hurry and was trying to end the contract quickly, and a bunch of priests from the Dorkalf side came?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Is it because of something that happened outside the village just now?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's nothing.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: If that's the case with the academy director, then that's probably the case. ha ha ha. Well, it'll be okay. I'll take some rest and then go back tomorrow.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: If you stay in a place where you have achieved your goal for a long time, the smell of money will disappear.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What does that mean….)

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Hehe, good luck then. Let’s see someday when something big happens.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: See you later, Mr. Lashur.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When will I see you again? . hmm… .
(Koren is running around the village, receiving complaints from tourists who are complaining of inconveniences. Then, he takes a breather when he realizes it's almost over.)

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Whoa… . I'm going to take a break now.

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: What happened to the hippopotamus and the hedgehog becoming sensitive and the appearance of animals they had never seen before?

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: The forest keepers should be fine... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Coren, how is the village?

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Yeah, it's okay. ah… .
(Koren realizes that he is trying to back away without realizing it and stops.)

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Sorry, I didn't know.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's okay. You didn't run away this time.

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Thank you for being kind to me. By the way, did anything happen to you two?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nothing much happened.

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Thank goodness. There were guests who came back a bit surprised. So I'm worried.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Coren is nice.

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: That's right. I'm kind of nice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… . Ah, Coren. Do you know the blue and red odd-eye elf with black hair?

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Huh? Chloris and you know that person? I only know that much about what happened because people talked about it.

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Strange… . I remembered seeing the bespectacled wizard my sister told me about earlier. But now I can't remember the story I knew.

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: What... ?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: You mean it reminds you of Zephyrus?

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Yes, Runton showed me through the forest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Thanks, Coren.

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: I'm sorry, sister.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's okay. Because it wasn't Coren's fault that he lost his memories.

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Right?
(Chloris smiles softly and nods.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Coren, then we'll go.

lines.speaker: 코렌
lines.text: Yeah, okay.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Would you like to wrap things up briefly before going to Director Leaf?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First of all, I heard stories from Mr. Rashur, several outsiders, and Riftrashir residents such as Runton and Coren... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Certainly not much happens to outsiders. However, only the village elves do not remember the man's name or what happened in the village.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: My memories of Zephyrus came back. I guess it's thanks to the letter.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: And seeing as the man called Merlin told Morgana he was ready, he's definitely trying to do something suspicious in the village.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: The problem is why... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Chloris, by the way. I heard that the Dokalf Priests suddenly arrived. What is it?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Elf priests rarely move. Moreover, dock elves, and dozens of priests, move at the call of a higher being.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A call from a higher being... . Uh, Mr. Chloris?
(Leaf is standing where Chloris' gaze rests, answering questions from the busy crowd of people.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Director Leaf… .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: The warden must know what the man is trying to do.

steps.name: Riftrasir's past
steps.objective: Talk to [Leef] in “Rifthrasir” and report the quest to [Clara] in “Crystal Moon Forest.”

lines.text: (The tourists leave and Leaf, who is taking a breather, is surprised to see two people approaching.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Are you two okay? I was worried because I couldn't see it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We're okay. Are other tourists okay?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Yes, everyone is safe.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I have a question for you, Director Leaf. The director already knew, right?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Well, what do you mean... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: When %s and I went to the forest, something happened... . And that something else would happen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Also, it's strange that the Dokhalf priests suddenly came to town.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Please tell me. The reason why priests appeared who didn't move at all.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Although the priests said it was a business agreement, there must have been separate instructions. So please tell me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: About the man who goes around with the witch.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I wanted to handle it quietly... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Although the residents of Riftrasir lost all memories of Zephyros ever appearing, only Director Leaf knew his name and what he was up to.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: The memory-manipulating witch probably couldn't grasp the Warden's full powers. Please tell me now. What happened to Zephyrus... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I realized it really late too. There's no way I wouldn't know what's happening in the forest and village, but it was a force so strong that I didn't even realize it.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I'm trying to get revenge on this village, so I'm going to stop it on my own... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: You couldn't stop it.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Let me help you. I have to find that person, and Chief Leaf has to save the village.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please tell me, Chief Leaf. The man is with the witch now.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Witch… .
(Leif bites his lip slightly when he hears the word witch.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I'll tell you. What should I talk about first? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Which one should I talk about first….)

lines.speaker: 리프
