lines.text: The child's name was Saleon. I lived with my mother in Liprrasir.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: 10 years ago, when the previous emperor of the empire suddenly passed away... . There was a rumor that it was because of a witch. As if trying to put those rumors to rest, the council nobles stepped forward and started looking for the witch.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: If I didn't have a witch, I tried to find a demon or Agashura.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I thought there wouldn't be any problems in Alfheim, where the elves live, but a villager reported it. Saleon is an elf born through the power of a dream demon, a type of demon.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: So he called me half-hearted… .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Saleon said that.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Even though elves are a bit closed-minded, I believed that they would not abandon their neighbors who have been in the village for a long time. That was my mistake.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: The person who reported the news spread the rumor to other residents, and the residents became agitated. And they attacked even me who was trying to protect them.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: On the night when they were about to send the two people away, a wizard from the Imperial Magic Agency appeared, kidnapped them and dragged them to the forest on the grounds that he was looking for demons.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: The wizard's purpose wasn't demons.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Here too, the Magic Agency….)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: The power of Saleon... . The potion the wizard had made the child grow wings that had never been seen before... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: And the wizard used magic to amplify Saleon's power.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: The villagers were frightened by the different look of Saleon and threw torches at him, calling him a devil. Saleon didn't know what to do, so he swung his arm, and one of the villagers was injured.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: The wizard who saw this said that Saleon was an evil demon, a descendant of the demon race, and the moment he used magic to create flames... . Mary, Saleon's mother, threw herself. To protect my son... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Maria's entire body was on fire as she was hit by the wizard's magic, and Saleon, who saw it, lost consciousness from shock... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: As soon as I opened my eyes again, I turned into a demon and went on a rampage, killing the wizard... . In the process, half of the Crystal Moon Forest and village were burned down.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Even I, who had been with the forest for a long time, couldn't stop it.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: So Saleon said he was sorry to me, cursed those who pushed him, and left. That was already 10 years ago... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They say that half of the village and forest were burned down, but when I look at it now, I don't think of anything like that.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I am the village chief of Riftrasir. I had to somehow bring the village back to life after Saleon left and it was in shambles. A warrior, the life and land he saved... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I didn't care if all the elves in Alfheim criticized me for being rich. If only we could sell the legend of the warrior so that our descendants can live well.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: A lot has happened... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I'm sorry, Director of Chloris Academy.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's not for Director Leaf to apologize.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Because of Riftrasir's incident, rumors about mixed race people spread even worse. Because we've done more in the past 10 years than we did hundreds of years ago.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Because people who look at people like me with a bad eye are bad.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Mr. Chloris….)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I thought it would resolve itself naturally over time. If you don't solve it properly, it will remain as a bad memory and come back... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Haha… .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Fifteen days ago, I heard a scream in the square and ran to it, and Saleon appeared and killed a person... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who was the dead person?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: The person who reported Saleon's identity didn't go his way, so he spread the word to the villagers and threw a torch at him... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: He was the one who opposed the growth of Riftrasir more than anyone else, but later he accumulated more wealth than anyone else in the village.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: That person was killed just as he had done to Saleon. Because I was scorched by fire and my heart was pierced... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I had to evacuate people to prevent this accident from getting worse and causing more victims. Because we can't repeat what happened 10 years ago... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Then one person was captured by Saleon. That man also tormented Saleon along with the dead man... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Just then, Mr. Zephyrus, who had been to the forest, returned and rescued the man who had been captured by Saleon.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: The moment Mr. Zephyrus told me to take that person with him, a kid wearing a devil's tail and a woman holding a pendant appeared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The woman holding the pendant is a witch. From another world... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: It was like that. The moment the witch raised her hand and sprayed a strange power from the pendant... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I was back home. It's as if nothing happened, I don't remember the situation... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Not only the village residents, but also the guests who stayed here for a while did not remember.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: When my memories came back, I realized. Even the fact that the person Saleon killed and the two people he tried to kill have disappeared from people's memories... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I also remember seeing Mr. Zephyros... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A witch named Morgana erased both me and Mr. Cloris's memories of meeting a kid named Mordred. and… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Leaf briefly about meeting Morgana and Merlin in the forest, excluding Hilda.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: The abilities of a witch named Morgana are beyond imagination. I heard you came from another world... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Haha… .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I called urgently. To stop the witch and Saleon... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: The Immortal Priests are monks who believe in the power and will of darkness, and they have been chasing witches for a long time because they believe they are causing the truth to go against the grain.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: There is a story that it is connected to the Magic Agency, but now is not the time to discuss that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Director Leaf, I heard from Mr. Cloris that such a group does not move easily... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I can guess that the director is a great person, but if he is enough to move the priests... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: That's what's important now... . No, I'll tell you. This is the warrior's authority.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Since ancient times, the village chief of Riftrasir has been delegated the authority of the warrior and can make any request to any group belonging to any church, including the elf church, Hodmis.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: However, if it is acceptable to the church, it will be processed immediately. It's a bit awkward because it's my first time asking for something like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is it simply a request from the village chief who has received the authority of a warrior from the church? I think there is more to it...)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I left it to the priests from Doc Alp, so it should be fine. I also asked you to ensure the safety of Mr. Zephyrus... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Still, I keep checking just in case. Oh, that's right... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: There's a bit of a problem. Priests from Dorkalf tend to be hostile to non-elves, so be careful when you meet them.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: … And %s… . For some reason, the priests didn't seem to like it very much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems like he doesn't want things to escalate. It's not the first time I've been hated, but it's still a bit disappointing. Ahaha… .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Saleon… . No, the boy, now Merlin, is here to seek revenge.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: And the witch will use Saleon like that. The witch will definitely be after something important to us.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is that?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: The power of a warrior... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The hero has been gone for a long time.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: The hero's power remains in Riftrasir.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: His power is divided between the Cathedral of Dusk and the Song of the Lost Stars.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Song of a lost star?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: … This is the place where he was buried to prevent the demons from taking his remaining power.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: On the outside, it looks like a large star-shaped decoration made to honor a legendary warrior, but you can get inside it in a special way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… . When Merlin said preparations were complete, there was still time for the stars to begin singing.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I figured out a way to enter the song of the stars from my memories... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: It's soon time for the star's song to begin. I have to go… . We must protect his power.
(Cloris catches Leaf as she panics and tries to leave.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Chief Leaf, no.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chief Leaf, stay with the villagers. Me and Mr. Chloris will go there.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Director Leaf, do as %s says. If we continue in this state, we can't do anything.
(Leaf nods as if he has made up his mind. He then holds the hands of Chloris and %s.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Merlin went into it… . However, it won't be easy to find where his power lies.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Now you two can go inside. I made it possible for you to go faster than Merlin... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Don't ask anything, just stop Merlin in there. In the meantime, Merlin and the witch won't be able to do anything about Riftrasir... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I'm sorry. Entrusted with the village's affairs... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: No, I'll be right back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Chloris, it's marked there on the map, right?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: If you go this way, it'll be quick.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, then let's go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If I'm going to deal with Merlin, who has the power of a dream demon, I need to prepare properly...)

steps.name: a song that never goes away
steps.objective: Defeat [Merlin] in “Song of the Lost Star” and report to [Chloris] in “In front of the Twilight Cathedral.”

lines.text: (At a dead end in the quiet Crystal Moon Forest, where everyone has left, a large star-shaped structure stands on small stone steps.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is the place Director Leaf was talking about.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I feel tremendous magical power within me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just a moment.
(As Adventurer extends his hand between the structures, the thin golden membrane spread out in front of him sparkles.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think you can go inside.
It's true. There is a story about someone going into this... .
(A female elf peeks her head out from behind the star-shaped structure.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Who are you?
Clara… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you from the village?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: From Riftrasir, but not now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you here alone? Earlier, Director Leaf told the people in the forest to come back...

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: I couldn't find inspiration, so I walked and walked and ended up here. Song of a lost star... .

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: I really like how you compared a warrior to a star and expressed his passing as a lost song... .

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: When I'm concentrating, I can't even hear Chief Leaf's voice... . The village chief is going to nag me again... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Inspiration?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: I just write about various topics… . I'll be back soon.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: But who are you... ? Everyone left, but only the two of them came here and said they were going inside... . I know Chief Leaf sent it, but... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Chloris, what should we do? I think I should talk to Clara... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Let me keep it simple.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Clara, I am a wizard named Chloris.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Ah… . I think I've heard your name. I also read the book.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: You mean the magic book?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: No, not that one. In the romance novel section of Belfar Library... .

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: It was really fun, what was the title... . Hmm.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Ahhh, don't think about it. Clara.
(Chloris reaches out and shakes her hand with a puzzled expression.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Because that's not important right now.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Yeah… . Then tell me something important... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I don't know how much I remember, but the person who left the village 10 years ago is back... .

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Ah, 10 years ago… .
(Clara nods as if she understands.)

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: It somehow looked familiar... . I was grateful at the time, but someone passed by and said… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you remember?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Remember? Ah, yes… . It wasn't a very good thing... . What happened? Obviously the name... . Obviously… .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: As expected... .

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: This is what it means to not remember. Okay, I'll go back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's dangerous to go alone, is that okay?
(As soon as %s's question ends, Leaf's voice echoes through the Crystal Moon Forest once again.)

lines.speaker: 리프의 목소리
lines.text: “Clara, wait there!! Runton is going!”

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: I'm fine alone... . It will be okay if Runton comes.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Then you have to stay here and then go back.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Yeah… .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Mr. %s, shall we go in now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I am ready.
(As Adventurer and Chloris slowly step between the large star structures, the golden curtain sparkles once again.)
(After a while, the two people slowly disappear, covered by a golden film.)

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: It was real... . A mysterious space where a legendary warrior entered… .
(When the light of various colors approaches and disappears to the point that it bothers the vision, the image of the space that could not be properly seen is revealed.)
(Under the moon, which appears to be burning in the shape of a ring, star- and moon-shaped pieces are falling on the ground.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Song of a lost star... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think all the beautiful star and moon shapes that people know are here... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Sure… . Wait a minute, Mr. %s, hey… .
(A man resembling a black wolf is standing on the small hill that Chloris points to.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Saleon… .
(Merlin jumps on the spot and lands in front of Chloris and %s.)

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: It's been a while since I heard that long-discarded name.

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Chief Leaf must have told you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why were you waiting?

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: I came to tell you. You are not the target of my revenge.

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Those who are not related to Riftrasir, go back. Otherwise nothing will happen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Even in Orcarium, El-Larsa told me to go back as if nothing happened...)

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: I promise... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you saying we should trust someone who killed someone?

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Whether you believe it or not is up to your will.

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: And they were the ones who would one day die by my hand.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I'm sorry it happened to you, but it doesn't mean you killed someone... .

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Killing someone with your own hands is never a good feeling. But, I… It has to be that way.

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Their very existence was denied in this strange state, and their family members died before their eyes. Are you telling me to stay still even after seeing that?

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Until now, my memories have been filled with negativity and my time with pain... , I couldn’t compensate for it with anything.

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Even in death, we need an ending that makes sense... , I wasn't ready for that... .
(At that moment, Merlin aims his pistol at Chloris.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Merlin!!
Bang! bang! bang!
(The startled Adventurer hurriedly ran toward Merlin, but flames had already exploded from the cool muzzle along with an intense sound.)
(However, the bullet is blocked before it reaches Chloris and falls to the floor.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I almost died... .
(The stems and leaves of the large plant in front of Chloris scatter and disappear.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Chloris, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I survived thanks to the spell I had memorized in advance.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew… . Thank goodness. I'm glad, but I don't think I can forgive you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Merlin!!
(%s's loud sound and a strong attack are directed at Merlin. However, %s's attack is bounced off helplessly the moment it touches Merlin's shield.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: I'd like to fit in, but not right now... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Mr. %s!! are you okay?
(A surprised Chloris approaches %s, while Merlin turns his back and jumps up the hill from where he came from.)

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: I heard it from Morgana. A person whom God cherishes... . There was something I wanted to ask, but I guess it would be meaningless anyway.

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: The God of Etoire ceased to be a God the moment he ran away... .

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Hehe, I have to finish first so Morgana can do it too.

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: It hasn't happened yet, but if you want to stop it, you'll have to get to the end of Star Song before me.
(With those words, Merlin comes down from the hill and runs towards somewhere. %s The group hurries after Merlin, but he is no longer visible.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I missed it… .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Mr. %s, shall we go in a different direction than the direction Merlin went?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: The reason Merlin said he would have to arrive before him was because he didn't know the way. Since we don't know each other's way, we have no choice but to go in different directions.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's probably our first time here, as well as Merlin's.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I will chase the magic flowing within this place, so please follow me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, let's hurry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Merlin's words are a bit confusing. It hasn't happened yet...)
(As I ran for a while along the hillside where the shining stars and moon fragments fell, I saw a structure in the distance that did not fit in here.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It’s a coffin… .
(It is full of a sacred feeling, perhaps because of the roots and stems of the star tree surrounding the white sarcophagus and the shining star pieces around it.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I feel a strong power there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that the power that Director Leaf was talking about?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Just go and check... .
(The moment you approach the sarcophagus with Chloris, you make eye contact with Merlin, who is leaning against the sarcophagus.)

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: It's a little late.
(Merlin stands up and looks at the %s group retreating.)

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: It was a good choice to come this far with that woman at the forefront. The song of a lost star, the power that flows here is only... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait a minute, what does that mean? If you're going to say something, you have to say it to the end.

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Humans hear it, but it is a story... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Merlin… .

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Let's make a deal... .

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Answer my question first. And take me down. Then I will give you the answer you want.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: There are a lot of conditions.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Chloris, from our perspective, it's the same no matter what you choose.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Merlin… .

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Do you think the hypocritical elves of Riftrasir are worthy?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: What kind of ridiculous question... .

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: I will ask you again. Do you think Liftrasir is worth it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who judges its value?

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: That's the answer. Even though they are not valuable enough for you to protect... .
(Merlin quietly fiddles with the pistol with his eyes closed.)

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Morgana… . The day has come when I will complete my revenge on Riftrasir and you will return to Azrael.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Chloris… .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Yes… .
(Just as the two are taking a step back to prepare for what is about to happen, Merlin opens his eyes. And black wings, which had not been seen before, sprout from his back.)

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: I will make it disappear forever from the memories of Etoire and the people... . You fools who will meet the same fate as Riftrasir.
(Chloris, who has used up all her magic while defending against Merlin's attack from afar, loses consciousness and falls down.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Chloris!!
Crash.
(A cold, cold feeling of metal approaches %s’s head.)

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Do you have any last words?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stop… .

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Do you think I can stop? If I could stop it, I would have stopped it a long time ago.

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: I'd rather beg for my life like other hypocrites in the face of death. That's a better way.

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Call on the name of the God you love, complain and curse. And kneel down and pray. Please save me!
(Merlin, whose expression was unreadable, continued to make an exaggerated statement.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't want to call Iris like that... .

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: You don't want salvation... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: At least my future won't end here and now.

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: You are already saved. A fool who doesn't even know that salvation is salvation... . Hahaha... .
(Merlin covers the burned part of his face with his hand and laughs maniacally.)

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Many lives looked to God for salvation in the face of misfortune. Even as I was dying, I cried out God’s name and prayed again and again.

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: The more hypocrites they were, the more they shouted out God's name. Please save me. They captured me and offered to give me money and sacrifices!

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Those whom I judged with my own hands and those who died unjustly were all fair before God. Because everyone died.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That doesn't mean... .

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: It's noisy!

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: You seem to think you are qualified to give me advice. Arrogant person... . Then what is that power you have?

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Even if it is God's protection, your current strength is probably achieved at the cost of someone else's death.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, that’s… .

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: What I heard from Morgana is true. A terrible hypocrite... .

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Remember, %s… . How vain and cursed your words are... .
(The moment Merlin puts strength into his fingers holding the pistol, someone suddenly appears from behind.)

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Don't disturb me, Mordred!

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Let’s hurry and play!
(Merlin's posture is disturbed by the appearance of Mordred, who shows his face to play.)

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Merlin, Merlin! Can I do it? Morgan said this was fun.

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Morgana?

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Yes!
(As soon as Mordred nods, he passes by Merlin with a bright smile.)
Faaat.
(With the sound of something exploding, %s's vision turns black.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what?! This is blood... .

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Mordred… . Why are you… . Ugh… .
(Merlin is barely holding his position while coughing up blood, but it looks like he will collapse at any moment.)

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Sorry, Merlin. Morgan said he needed something. That's right! The blood of demons hungry for anger and revenge!
(Mordred himself is scratching his head as if he doesn't know what he's talking about. Then, before he knows it, he opens the potion bottle he brought and checks what's inside.)

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Hmm. Good blood! It's good to have Merlin's blood in here!
(Black blood drips from the tip of Mordred's spear and soon fills the potion bottle.)

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: … Is that so... .

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: They just needed my blood... . Ugh… .
(Merlin sits down with a vain look on his face.)

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Eh… , it's a little lacking. Morgan, can I bleed the lock too?
(Mordred looks at %s's face and asks someone a question. Then Morgana's voice is heard as if she were right next to him.)

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: I don't need any other blood, Mordred. And he was the key. It's not a lock. Anyway, come back with Merlin's blood.

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Oh, that's right. Did you say it was a key? Hehe. But the lock is cuter! You are the lock key! I'm going to Morgan now! Let’s play together later! Okay?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (We can’t relax yet. Mr. Chloris is still….)
(As Mordred waves his hand and says hello, a black shadow rises from behind him. It wraps itself around Mordred and takes him somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Morgana!!

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: Merlin, why? I just did what you wanted. Because I said I would help you get revenge.
(Every time Morgana speaks, the black shadow grows larger and smaller repeatedly.)

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: Your blood will do what I will and what you will. Trust me. Your revenge will soon be complete. Trust me... .

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: How much did you trust me?

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: I covered up the memories of my anxious feelings with faith and even gave him the strength that Arthur had left, but I guess it wasn't enough.

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Wait… . I am now... . My memories... .?

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: You don’t have to think about it, Merlin. And now I'll get it back. I don't need you anymore... .
(Morgana's voice disappears and Merlin's movements stop. After a moment, the star song begins to be filled with Merlin's screams.)

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: Ugh, ugh. Wow!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Merlin? Now, wait a minute. This is... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The fear and fear I once felt… this….)
(As Merlin suffers, black blood continues to seep out from the wounds inflicted by Mordred's attack.)
(The black blood that fell on the ground gradually begins to erase the sparkling light of the space.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This, this… . So, it’s bondage… . Different from back then... .

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: %s, nothing you say can stop me now. After everything is ready, I will go back. His time will make me go faster.

lines.speaker: 멀린
lines.text: I wanted to take revenge with my own hands... , I want an ending like this... It wasn't... … .
(No more words are heard from Merlin. No movement is seen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Merlin… ?

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: Just as Arthur tried to do, all life in Riftrasir would evaporate and all power within the cathedral would disappear.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Shut up, witch! How dare you try to ruin this place! It won't go your way. witch.
(At that time, a leaf appears in front of %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Director Leaf?

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: The warrior's coffin contaminated with the blood of demons, its power will never return... .
(Leaf winks slightly, and the black liquid that flowed around the pipe disappears without a trace.)

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: That's interesting.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Hehe, that's about it.

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: What a fun elf. Anyway, I have no strength left here, so I'm leaving. Because you too will evaporate tonight anyway.
(After finishing speaking, Morgana's voice disappears, and the black shadow that filled part of the space also disappears.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Phew… . I'll take a breather. Wake up, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? yes… .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I'll take care of Merlin, so get out of here with Academy Director Chloris and go to the cathedral.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Cathedral… .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: The immortal priests went to the cathedral. Perhaps the witch's power was felt there.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: We need your help. Please.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: And goddess. Please lead this elf who is lacking... . I will work hard to ensure that the mistake is not repeated again... .
(With the small voice of the riff, the star structures in the star song begin to shine brightly, erasing everything around them one by one.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Director!!

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Mr. %s… ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Director!!

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Are you okay, Director?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Director!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh?

(The surrounding scenery is as beautiful and full of bright light as it was the first time. Only then does Adventurer look at the surrounding situation and look at Chloris as if nothing had happened.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay, Chloris?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Mr. %s, I was surprised at how natural it was.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: By the way, I think the method you used woke me up and helped me recover… .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Take a look. Looks okay, right?
(Chloris raises one arm as if nothing is wrong.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a relief.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As the director said, let’s go to the cathedral quickly. I'll tell you more details on the way to the cathedral!

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Yes!

steps.name: witch morgana
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Chloris] in front of the Twilight Cathedral. 
2. Enter the 「Cathedral of Dusk」 and defeat [Morgana] to obtain <Pendant of Loss>. Then report the quest to [Chloris] in “In front of the Twilight Cathedral.”

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: … Something like that happened.
(Cloris looks sad when she learns what happened during the time she was unconscious.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: How should I say this... . Phew… .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I can feel the magic power of Zephyrus inside.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I were to guess based on what Morgana said... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because this isn't certain... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's okay, just say it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The power of the vice shook the place where the spirit of time lived. So a gap was created, and the flow of time within it affected Windy Seed... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Windy Seed made the two of you look different.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: The impact of that remains with me. Probably Zephyrus too. Unlike me, some of the ability of time is... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah! Morgana said his time would make him go faster.
(Chloris' face turns blue after hearing %s's words.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Morgana quickly returns to the time of Zephyrus... . Jeffy, no… .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Morgana is trying to use Zephyrus as a catalyst.  You must not lose all your magic power in the process.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Jeffy, Jeffy… .
(The moment Chloris rushes to enter the cathedral, a soft and warm wind pushes her out.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Zephyrus, don’t do this… , please… .
(Chloris tries to go inside once more, but the same thing happens. The wind continues to blow, preventing Chloris from entering.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Chloris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please wait here.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: But… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will stop Morgana and come out with Zephyrus, so please wait.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still, I don't know, so if I don't come out even after a lot of time passes... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Don't say that, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I won't say anything like this, so please trust me and wait.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Yes… , I will try my best.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll come back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (By the way… how can we find it in such a large cathedral? Let’s go inside first.)
(As you enter the cathedral, there are structures erected so huge and majestic that they fill your vision.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's amazing... .  To think of building a building like this in one corner of the forest... . Ah, this is not the time to be like this. You have to hurry.
(Mordred appears next to %s, who is rushing away, and starts running with him.)

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Lock key, where are you going?

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Play! Let's play together~.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't come to play.

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Hmm, I played with Arthur!
(%s's steps naturally stop at the word Arthur.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arthur… . You mean vise?

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know me because of Vice? When did you know?

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: When… ? When was that… It was so.

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Ah! From the moment Arthur came to Etoire!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you’ve been with Vice since then…? .

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: No, no. I was born a while ago.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you?

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Me? If I answer, will you play?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah, yeah... .

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Hehe, I composed Arthur's memories into a factor, and then made a homunculus that Morgana created with that.
(Mordred sees %s on alert and continues to beg to play, when Morgana's voice is heard from somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: Mordred, you dare say something like that... . I told you not to do that, right?

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Because you're Arthur's friend, %s, my friend!

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: It wasn't the intended result, but our Mordred looks a bit like this... .

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Yeah, I'm usually like this. lock key. lol.

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: Mordred, no play is allowed here. Instead, we play hide and seek inside.

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Great! good! But what is hide and seek?

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: Ah… , it seems there is no hide and seek in Arthur’s memories… . Then I will tell you.

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: The person who hides is called Mordred, the person who searches is called %s, and the person who searches is called the tagger.

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: Hide Mordred for a while and kill him when the tagger appears. Sounds fun, right?

lines.speaker: 모드레드
lines.text: Yes, yes!! Looks like fun! Then the lock key is a tagger! I'll go and hide!
(Mordred, hearing the ridiculous rules of hide and seek, cheers and disappears into the distance.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's annoying... .

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: %s, now the beings I gave you distorted memories will rush towards you.

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: Not knowing that everything in Riftrasir would disappear.

lines.speaker: 모르가나의 목소리
lines.text: I'm not waiting for you. I will already be back before you arrive.
(As Morgana's voice disappears, beings with distorted memories due to the witch's curse begin to flock instead.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Witch Morgana... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It won't go your way.
(A strange being is walking through a space filled with sacred light and so dazzling light.)
(Then, when I suddenly see the scenery of the crystal moon forest outside the window, I approach the window.)

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Since coming to this world, I have never thought of it as beautiful... , as beautiful as Azrael… .

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Unfortunately, Arthur disappeared without knowing the beauty of this world, but hehe. I'm happy.

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: … There's not much time left... .

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: I have obtained the blood of someone darker than pitch black, and I also have the power of time to be used as a catalyst. Now all you have to do is wait in this place where the holy power remains... .
(At that time, as someone opens the chapel door and walks in, a shadow appears on Morgana's face.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Witch Morgana, I've been waiting for you.

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: It arrived sooner than expected, %s… .
(Morgana's expression slightly trembles when %s asks if she was waiting.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I never thought the most important place in the cathedral would be at the top.

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: You somehow made it this far. There is no child like Mordred who doesn't know how to give up... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's my first time playing hide and seek like this, but it wasn't bad. I had a hard time avoiding it... .

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Mordred is a child I created out of memories of when Arthur was at his strongest. For comparison, it will be stronger than the Requiem made by Arthur.

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: It helped a lot as Arthur met sinners from different timelines and interfered with other timelines. Was it Chimaera? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That means… .

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Hehe, you must be surprised. I thought you knew… .

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: According to the will of the merciful Merlin, I would like to offer you one more recommendation. What do you mean?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Beg for your life?

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: If you understand it that way, then try it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I don't trust you. You already showed me everything... .

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: You mean the things you said to Merlin?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Merlin knew and accepted it, so what's the problem? That's how the whole world works.

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: What you believed in can fall apart and rise up all at once. A difference of one piece of paper.

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: I don't think it's any different that you've come this far. Because you have your own purpose and meaning... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Morgana… . Just spitting out contradictory words like Vice.

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Don't insult Arthur.

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: If you had been the key, Arthur and I would have already gone back... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Well, if you were thinking properly, you wouldn't have done that.

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Phew… .

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: The waiting moment was boring... , it just worked out well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will, on my own, cut you off from everything related to Vice.

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Because right and wrong don't matter anymore.

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: I'll make it so that no one remembers you and there can't even be a trace of you at any time.

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: I didn't think I would last this long. This is the last one... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don't know if there will be a gap, but I have no choice but to aim for it...)

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Finally… .
(The moment Morgana tries to turn light from the pendant into a weapon, the light gradually turns dark and stops moving.)

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: What is it? Why are you like this... .

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Oh my... medical charge… .
(Morgana seems to be embarrassed and shakes the pendant, but the light that has turned black does not return to its original state.)

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Black power... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I don't know what's going on, but let's get this over with.
(Morgana, who had been attacking a lot just a moment ago, is helplessly losing the pendant to %s.)

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think this is a tool to amplify abilities. I'll handle it properly as you say.

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Stop it!!
(Despite Morgana's cries, the pendant that fell to the ground is destroyed by %s's attack. As such, the black light hovering around Morgana and the pendant becomes blurred.)
(After a while, the sound of glass breaking continues to be heard inside.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this sound... .

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Mordred!! Come here!! Come here and kill your playmate!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Morgana, it's over. Give up... .

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Mordred will kill you... .
(As Morgana is unable to contain her excitement, a large shadow curtain rises from behind. And from the gap, a large staff wrapped in a plant stem rises and taps Morgana on the shoulder.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That cane….)

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Mordred, come quickly. Me, kill that woman!! Why is there no answer?
I borrowed some of your power. With your ability to manipulate memories and distort space... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A voice I heard somewhere..., no way...)
I sent him into an eternity of wanting to play.
Tuk.

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Mode… Red?
(A purple helmet falls in front of Morgana.)
A life created based on someone's memories... . It's not like I was born again, but it's definitely... .
(Morgana sees the helmet on the ground and sits down and hugs it. After a while, a woman holding a staff slowly comes forward from behind Morgana.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you… .
Is this your first time seeing it like this? You may not want to say hello to me, but you should introduce yourself properly.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I'm Daphne.
(The moment the woman reveals her name, the cathedral shakes violently again.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: He was the leader of the Kali clan a long time ago... .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Now I'm just one witch you know.
(When Daphne smiles, a barrier of unknown power is erected around her. Just then, Adventurer, which was rushing towards Daphne, is thrown back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: That's hasty. Still, I give you good marks for trying to test me.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I have nothing to do with you today.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … What are you going to do with Morgana?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Just like the ending of a person destined to be a witch.
(The moment Daphne finishes speaking, everything in the field of vision becomes distorted.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … This, this… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, ugh… . Ooh, I can't move.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Don't be scared, %s. Because it’s not like bondage.
(Daphne looks at Morga, who is still sitting down and holding her helmet.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Morgana.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Don't you know that too?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: What is the end of someone who touches life... .

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: You, you too... .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Yes. I too will see the end someday. But not now. now… .

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Please, save me. me… , I am… . I didn't come here because I wanted to. When I opened my eyes, it was here. But, but!!

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: The damn black moon made me like this! They forced me to become a witch... .

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Although it was a different time, Arthur could return if he succeeded... . I thought I would succeed this time and go back... .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: So you tried to take advantage of the life here. Bring back all the power that was left in Avalon like dross. A young man who lived an ordinary life was awakened into a high-ranking demon by manipulating his memory... .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Morgana… , The number of our clan you have touched is large. That number of you are now… .
(Daphne looks at Morgana's face looking at her. Then she taps his shoulder with the staff she was holding.)

lines.speaker: 모르가나
lines.text: Daphne… … , Daphne!!
(Morgana's image hidden by the barrier splits into several pieces like a mirror breaking.)
Faaah!
(And the pieces rise up and fall to the floor with a loud bang.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: This is it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne, what are you doing now... .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: That's because she's a witch.
(Daphne looks at the piece of glass that was Morgana just moments ago. As the piece of glass gradually falls out like powder, Daphne smiles, probably satisfied.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: … I guess I'll have to test Morgana's power.
(Daphne makes the unfolded barrier disappear and slowly approaches %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you planning to erase my memories?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Think however you want. Although having your memories erased may seem harsh to you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne, what are you doing this for?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Can I be honest with you?
(At that moment, darkness begins to creep in around Daphne and %s. The darkness gradually swallows everything, as if the cathedral with its brilliant light never existed.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: A witch of destiny who must move. That's me. And what I want is to change the fate of this star before night comes... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne!!
(%s's memory stops there, ending with the witch's smile visible through the darkness.)
(The world that was full of darkness suddenly returns to bright light, and Adventurer, which was standing, collapses.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… , my head hurts… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Apparently, I fought Morgana, took the pendant and broke it... . And Daphne... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah! Memories, memories were not erased.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne said she would test Morgana's strength... .

lines.speaker: 도크알프 사제들
lines.text: Is this the person Director Leaf was talking about…? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?
(The priests of the Immortal Priesthood come to the side of %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The priests who were attacking me just a moment ago...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes. Looking for someone... .

lines.speaker: 도크알프 사제들
lines.text: Ah, if it’s that wizard… . I have already returned to the village with the warden.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Already?

lines.speaker: 도크알프 사제들
lines.text: Already? I've been looking for you and the director for hours since they said you wouldn't come back, but I never thought you'd be here... .

lines.speaker: 도크알프 사제들
lines.text: There's a half-elf outside... . No, your group is waiting for you, so go ahead.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes… .

lines.speaker: 도크알프 사제들
lines.text: And thank you. Thank you for driving out the thieves who entered the cathedral. Thanks to this, we were able to protect the cathedral items.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The people who tried to attack me were thieves...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew… . The priests will clean up the cathedral, so I will go to Mr. Chloris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (By the way, the approaching night means Walpurgis Night...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne… .

steps.name: reverberation of memory
steps.objective: Talk to [Chloris] in “In front of the Twilight Cathedral”, then return to “Rifthrasir” and report the quest to [Leef].

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Mr. %s!!
(Chloris runs after seeing %s coming out of the cathedral.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Chloris!

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: … Are you okay? Are you hurt anywhere?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it's okay. So don't worry.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Haven't your memories been erased? I'm afraid you might not recognize me... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The teacher who destroyed the school... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Thank goodness!! I remember correctly. But what?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Since we can't destroy the school, can we help you destroy it somewhere?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I’ll decline… .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Just kidding, kidding!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It seemed sincere, didn’t it?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems like the people in the cathedral have returned to normal... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: That's right. When we came back, we dispersed according to Director Leaf's instructions and looked for Mr. %s. But where have you been all this time?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Chloris what happened in the upper chapel of the cathedral.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Daphne originally had the ability to erase memories... . You defeated Morgana and inherited her powers?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I can't believe it... . How could that... .
Something like that happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That person….)
(A man, identical to Notos, but with a slightly different atmosphere, walks out from behind the tree.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Different colored eyes, tightly closed lips, horn-rimmed glasses... . It's a little different, but it's the same. Definitely twins... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Ah, Jeffy… . Are you okay?
I don't mind. There %s, this must be your first time seeing it like this, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Zephyrus… .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Call me Zephyrus.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Zephyrus. I've been looking for it for a while.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I didn't know that so much time had passed. I just went into the forest to find the flow as written in the magic book, and that was the end... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: So carefree. I, no, we searched for a long time... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: It's not that I was carefree, I didn't know anything, Chloe. I'd like to say it's ridiculous, but I've already experienced it.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I even had a conversation with a strange clock that beeped and honked without me even realizing it and a talking cat... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: What is that... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Okay… . If I say this, you might think I'm crazy, but it's true. Chloe… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Chloris, what Zephyrus said is correct.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: As expected, %s, I trust you.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Is this true, Mr. %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There is a spirit world with a talking owl clock and a cat. I want to rest too, boo. I need to sleep. Let's talk like this.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Right... Okay… .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: … Chloe, it's all on your face.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Anyway, I'm sorry to Chloe and %s... . I thought I had the ability to escape danger, but I never thought the incident would get this big... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But where was Zephyrus when he came to his senses?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: … It was an upper attic of the cathedral. There were traces of a barrier placed by someone, and it was the work of a witch... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: %s, I have something to say. It's not something I want to say here, but I'd like you to visit the academy's main building later... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can you tell me a little bit about what the story is about?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: The Magic Agency that I have investigated, what it has done, and what it will do in the future... ..

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I'll send you a message later when I have time... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I understand. Then, I'll go to the magic academy.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Oh, Chief Leaf said he had something to say when he got back to town... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The director…?)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: We'll go back to the magic academy right away, %s... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Us?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Yes, us. Why is that, Chloe?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: No, it's nothing... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I need your help. Chloe.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Ugh, yeah… .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: %s, see you later. We have something to talk about here for a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then, I will go to the village and meet the warden.  See you later, you two... .
(After Adventurer leaves for the village, the priests in the cathedral also disappear somewhere, taking with them thieves disguised as detectives.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It will be quiet now. right?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Chloe… .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: First, let me say I'm sorry. Now I'm going to tell you why you had no choice but to leave the Magic Agency... .
(Leaf, who was sitting on the bench, puts his head back and looks at the sky. Then, he spots %s.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Ah, %s, there you are.
(Leaf gets up from his chair and takes %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Thank you. For protecting the village... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. What I did... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: There's no need to be too humble. I would be grateful if they could spend their golden years in our village... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you kidding?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Yes… . Something feels empty in my heart, so I keep telling strange jokes. sorry… .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I know that nothing bad happened after meeting the two witches at the cathedral, but I still sent a group of priests to find them just in case.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Uh, but… . What do you want to say... . Also, how did you know you met the two witches?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I am the chief of this village. Although it is faint, I can feel the memories based on the Crystal Moon Forest.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: From the moment the warrior returned to the village after a long journey, this place was my life itself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm not sure, but I think I heard something great.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for helping me with the song of the stars. But how did Merlin... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: The song of the stars, the bright stars permeating the ground, are the memories of all life that lived in the Crystal Moon Forest. Our ancestors who have passed away are also there.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: So I had Merlin, or rather Saleon, stay with my mother. Little star, big star... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I just wanted to let you know that Maria is there... . It's too late.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. The director did everything he could... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: And I'll tell you one more thing you need to know. What should I say about this… . It's so strange.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is that?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I remember everything, but the residents of Riftrasir and the others... . All memories related to Saleon have been erased. Even those related to the people Saleon killed.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: And the memories of the half-elves being reluctant because they were considered ominous and the priesthood being hostile towards humans... . As if it never happened from the beginning... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: It seems like a witch named Daphne has somehow solved the problem in her own way... . What should I say about this… .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: It's a little depressing that this is a memory that only remains for someone else.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne changed Riftrasir's memories like this... . What on earth are you thinking?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Sure… .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Phew… . I will do whatever it takes. 10 years ago, I was able to overcome the memories that everyone thought were a nightmare.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Now I don't care if this is right or wrong. After all, people remember things the way they like.
(Leaf smiles and stretches again.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I just need to rest for a few days. Without any thought... Just a few days... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Oh, I was just talking about myself. By the way, you didn’t feel down because of my story, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a little complicated. Similar to Director Leaf, but a little different... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: You must have been through a lot during this time.
(Leaf looks into %s's eyes and nods as if he felt something.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Looks like you need some rest too... . Just relax and don't think about anything for a while. We will provide you with every convenience while you are here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Director.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The director said that people remember things the way they like... I think both Morgana and Merlin are like that. Me too...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Could this be the answer? I don’t know yet….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Seeing as Daphne, who has not been seen for a while, appears, something must have happened….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I need to take a break and then go find Iris. I said it was okay, so I’m sure it will be okay, but….)
